parameters.content:
## FLOOWBOX - Conference CFP Monitor
Built specifically for MS in AI admissions prep.
A publication (even a workshop paper) significantly strengthens applications.
Runs weekly Monday.
2 parallel Perplexity searches:
- Major conference CFPs (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL)
- Workshop + demo track CFPs (easier entry point)
GPT-4o identifies best matches for research topics + recommends entry-level venues.
Saves to Notion + Slack alert.
